verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly claim the ability to 'trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start,' which directly matches the story, but this is a single first-party marketing/docs snippet with no elaboration on codebase-mapping features (e.g., semantic search, dependency graphs) and no independent or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the actual codebase-understanding mechanism (indexing, search, architecture visualization), and independent verification that it works well in practice.
